intended_object: The polynomial (semi)ring k[x₀, …, xₙ] in n+1 variables over a commutative semiring k. It is the source ring of the monomial parametrization xᵢ ↦ a^(n−i) b^i of the rational normal curve. Inferred from the docstring and from how the module uses it.
explanation: The abbreviation unfolds to `MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k`, which is exactly the polynomial semiring in the variables x₀, …, xₙ indexed by `Fin (n+1)`. That matches the docstring. It is a specific ring: the coordinate ring of projective n-space, in which the rational normal curve of degree n lives. So the index type `Fin (n+1)` belongs to the object itself and is not an artificial restriction. The coefficients are an arbitrary commutative semiring, which is the most general setting that makes sense here. The definition is only a convenient name for Mathlib's `MvPolynomial` and adds no conditions of its own.
